thread:
marie: quick brain-dump: Proposal to use a composable routing policy (tier + compliance flag) evaluated at request-time to avoid N-permutations of slices. Goal: support premium/deluxe/pooled + compliance without exploding control-plane. Thoughts?

alex: sounds good. main risk is policy eval latency on the hot path. we need a microbenchmark.

priya: customers (finance + health) will pay for premium with region+model pin. product needs console controls and CS changeability.

ben: runtime note: KV cache fragmentation is a real worry. suggest hot-cache reservations or warmup tokens for premium. need sim.

jason: ops: must have deterministic selection (stable-hash + affinity score) and an evacuation runbook. example: `evacuate --slice S --grace 180s --redirect fallback`.

luis: prioritization gates: 1) cache sim + policy-eval perf, 2) 2 paid premium pilots, 3) cost model within 15%. If sales lines up pilots, mark High.

marie: pilot plan: premium pilot (2 paying tenants) + standard pilot (8 tenants) for 4 weeks. metrics: p50/p95/p99, cache hit-rate, tokens/100k cost, migration incidents. launch criteria: premium p95 <= 10% delta, premium availability >= 99.95%, cost within 20%.

ops-bot: Follow-up meeting created: "routing composition follow-up" Thu 9:30am (30m)  attendees: marie, alex, ben, jason, priya, luis

marie: action items: @ben run KV sim, @alex prototype policy-eval microbench, @jason draft evacuation playbook, @luis compute cost model. Thanks all :thumbsup:
